description: Who owns this wallet, and what is their reputation? The Ethos profile holding an EVM address: display name, X handle and other linked accounts, credibility score and status, XP, influence factor, and review and vouch counts. Use it to attach a name and trust level to a counterparty address before a trade, transfer, airdrop or allowlist decision, or to screen addresses in a transaction for known bad actors. Free, no payment or key; the same answer as the free Ethos API. Example input: {"address":"0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045"}. Example output: {"id":32936,"profileId":1,"displayName":"vitalik.eth","username":null,"avatarUrl":"https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2074951227599646720/85k3GJ-s.jpg","score":1311,"status":"INACTIVE","userkeys":["profileId:1","service:x.com:1234567890","address:0x1234…"],"xpTotal":4076702,"influenceFactor":276,"stats":{"review":{"received":{"positive":120,"neutral":3,"negative":2}},"vouchTotals":[{"token":{"id":"eth","address":null,"decimals":18},"count":{"given":0,"received":40},"balance":{"given":"0","received":"1250000000000000000"}}]}}
